findings.text: errorPrevLine sets pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 and pos.Line-- without bounds checks; on empty file (lx.pos=0, lx.line=1), this produces Position{Line: 0, Start: -1} violating the line>=1 contract and causing invalid byte offset.
errorf's atEOF branch (lines 400-407) has the same defect: pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 and pos.Line-- produce invalid Position{Line: 0, Start: -1} when lexing empty input that hits EOF immediately.

1.reason: The errorf atEOF branch (lines 400-407) has the same root cause as the reference bug: it decrements the line and sets Start to lx.pos - 1, which produces an invalid Position when the lexer is at EOF on empty input, just like the reference bug's mechanism of reporting errors on the previous line at EOF.
